use std::future::{Future, ready};
use std::pin::Pin;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::task::{Context, Poll, Waker};
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use tokio_util::sync::{PollSender, ReusableBoxFuture};

fn reserve(sender: &mut PollSender<u32>, context: &mut Context<'_>) {
    match sender.poll_reserve(context) {
        Poll::Ready(Ok(())) => {}
        _ => panic!("expected capacity"),
    }
}
fn closed(sender: &mut PollSender<u32>, context: &mut Context<'_>) {
    match sender.poll_reserve(context) {
        Poll::Ready(Err(error)) => assert_eq!(error.into_inner(), None),
        _ => panic!("expected closed channel"),
    }
}
struct Step {
    value: u32,
    pending: bool,
    drops: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
}
impl Future for Step {
    type Output = u32;
    fn poll(self: Pin<&mut Self>, context: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<u32> {
        let this = self.get_mut();
        if this.pending {
            this.pending = false;
            context.waker().wake_by_ref();
            Poll::Pending
        } else { Poll::Ready(this.value) }
    }
}
impl Drop for Step {
    fn drop(&mut self) { self.drops.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst); }
}
struct Large { words: [u64; 32] }
impl Future for Large {
    type Output = u32;
    fn poll(self: Pin<&mut Self>, _: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<u32> {
        Poll::Ready(self.words[0] as u32)
    }
}
fn main() {
    let mut context = Context::from_waker(Waker::noop());
    let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::channel(1);
    let mut sender = PollSender::new(tx);
    assert!(sender.get_ref().is_some());
    reserve(&mut sender, &mut context);
    sender.send_item(11).unwrap();
    assert!(sender.poll_reserve(&mut context).is_pending());
    assert!(sender.abort_send());
    assert!(sender.poll_reserve(&mut context).is_pending());
    assert_eq!(rx.try_recv().unwrap(), 11);
    reserve(&mut sender, &mut context);
    sender.send_item(22).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(rx.try_recv().unwrap(), 22);
    reserve(&mut sender, &mut context);
    assert!(sender.abort_send());
    reserve(&mut sender, &mut context);
    sender.close();
    assert!(sender.is_closed());
    assert!(sender.get_ref().is_none());
    sender.send_item(33).unwrap();
    closed(&mut sender, &mut context);
    assert_eq!(sender.send_item(44).unwrap_err().into_inner(), Some(44));
    assert_eq!(rx.try_recv().unwrap(), 33);
    drop(sender);
    assert_eq!(rx.try_recv().unwrap_err(), mpsc::error::TryRecvError::Disconnected);

    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel(1);
    let mut sender = PollSender::new(tx);
    drop(rx);
    closed(&mut sender, &mut context);
    assert!(sender.is_closed());
    assert_eq!(sender.send_item(55).unwrap_err().into_inner(), Some(55));

    let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::channel(1);
    let mut sender = PollSender::new(tx);
    reserve(&mut sender, &mut context);
    sender.send_item(7).unwrap();
    assert!(sender.poll_reserve(&mut context).is_pending());
    sender.close();
    closed(&mut sender, &mut context);
    assert_eq!(rx.try_recv().unwrap(), 7);
    assert_eq!(rx.try_recv().unwrap_err(), mpsc::error::TryRecvError::Disconnected);

    let drops = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
    let mut future = ReusableBoxFuture::new(Step { value: 7, pending: true, drops: drops.clone() });
    assert!(future.poll(&mut context).is_pending());
    assert!(future.try_set(Step { value: 9, pending: true, drops: drops.clone() }).is_ok());
    assert_eq!(drops.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
    assert!(future.poll(&mut context).is_pending());
    assert_eq!(future.poll(&mut context), Poll::Ready(9));
    future.set(ready(13));
    assert_eq!(drops.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 2);
    assert_eq!(future.poll(&mut context), Poll::Ready(13));
    assert!(future.try_set(ready(17)).is_ok());
    assert_eq!(future.get_pin().poll(&mut context), Poll::Ready(17));
    let mut large = match future.try_set(Large { words: [99; 32] }) {
        Err(future) => future,
        Ok(()) => panic!("different layouts must not reuse"),
    };
    assert_eq!(Pin::new(&mut large).poll(&mut context), Poll::Ready(99));
    future.set(Step { value: 23, pending: true, drops: drops.clone() });
    assert!(future.poll(&mut context).is_pending());
    assert_eq!(future.poll(&mut context), Poll::Ready(23));
    drop(future);
    assert_eq!(drops.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 3);
    println!("tokio-util default: sender 11 22 33 closed; reusable 9 13 17 23 drops 3");
}
